properties.evidence: propagate.rs walks one store, per dec:nested-graphs. Its ImpactedNode row (node_id, node_type, distance, direction, via, crosses_risk_edge, crosses_published_boundary, centrality) has no field saying a node is mirrored from another design. So a radius that reaches a mirrored interface cannot say where it left (measured on 0.79.0 with a mirrored surface).
